revision_draft_not_run_report.why: A revision draft was asked of a run for a report that run did not make, or whose report can no longer be read; the user asks the run that made the report.

revision_draft_run_state.why: Only a completed run drafts a report revision; the user waits for the run to finish, or writes the edit themselves.

revision_draft_limit.why: The run is already drafting, or has drafted ten times; the user waits for the draft in flight, or writes the edit themselves.

revision_draft_not_drafted.why: Only a drafted revision can be applied or set aside; another click came first, or the draft was rejected, refused or lost.

revision_draft_not_found.why: No such revision draft on this run for this report; the user reloads the run card.
